note: CI: new JNI dispatch performance regression gate (jni-bench-gate.yml). PRs touching vespera_inprocess, vespera_jni or vespera-bridge build the merge base and the PR head (rust-jni-demo cdylib with pinned code alignment + bridge JAR) and measure dispatchBytes, dispatchDirect, dispatchStreaming, dispatchFullStreaming (64 KiB POST) and dispatchAsync in 5 interleaved paired rounds, one fresh JVM per side per round; a mode fails when the median paired change exceeds +30% and every round exceeds +20%, the same rule as the criterion gate. Harness: libs/vespera-bridge/bench/JniDispatchBench.java; runnable locally via scripts/jni-bench-interleaved.sh.
